mapper.select: SELECT id, sign_code AS signCode, course_id AS courseId, status, create_time AS createTime, expire_time AS expireTime FROM sign_codes WHERE sign_code = #{signCode} AND status = 'active' AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sign_codes SET status = 'expired' WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'active'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sign_codes WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time < #{now}
